generation.promptA:

At upper center, one large antique-gold dragon egg rests alone in a brass warming cradle; the egg has exactly three large vivid-turquoise diamond spots arranged vertically and clearly visible. At lower center, the recurring friendly young red baby dragon sits fully visible on a round cream cushion and wears one oversized cobalt-blue bow tie. At lower left, a cheerful mouse apprentice in a deep teal robe holds one large coral-red magic wand whose tip is a simple five-point star. At upper right, exactly four large sunflower-yellow potion bottles stand in one straight row on an isolated pale shelf, clearly separated with empty space between them. At lower right, one large round plum-purple cauldron is fully visible; its cream front medallion bears one oversized vivid-turquoise crescent-moon emblem. Include one gentle owl teacher, two additional small dragon eggs without spots, blank books, folded blankets, plain jars, clouds beyond the windows, and tiny golden sparkles only as supporting atmosphere. Keep the three egg spots, blue bow tie, coral star wand tip, four yellow bottles, and turquoise cauldron emblem large, crisp, unobstructed, spatially separated, and away from the outer 3% safe margin. No readable signs, labels, letters, numbers, runes, logos, or clock numerals..
